howItWorks.title: From idea to interactive in 3 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: You provide the topic. Our AI handles the heavy lifting. You reap the rewards.

step1.title: Feed the AI
step1.desc: Just type a topic, paste an article, or upload your notes. The AI understands the context instantly.

step2.title: Auto-Generate
step2.desc: Within seconds, get a fully structured, engaging quiz with perfectly calibrated difficulty.

step3.title: Share & Collect
step3.desc: Publish with one click. Watch the leads or grades roll into your beautifully designed dashboard.

features.title: Everything you need to convert
features.subtitle: Powerful tools packed into a ridiculously simple interface designed for maximum engagement.

feat1.title: Lead Generation Engine
feat1.desc: Create highly viral interactive "Lead Magnets" that capture emails effortlessly. Lower your CAC and skyrocket your engagement rate.

feat2.title: Automated Grading
feat2.desc: Anti-cheat controls, automatic grading, and instant results export to save you hours.

feat3.title: Deep Analytics
feat3.desc: Real-time metrics. Discover who answered what and measure your campaign performance.

feat4.title: Integrates with everything
feat4.desc: Export your leads directly to Mailchimp, Hubspot, or download as CSV. Your data goes wherever you need it.
